# `armada version`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Print build information and the latest release.

```
armada version [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada version             # this client, the servers, and the latest release
armada version -o json
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
